## VisuallyHidden.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `as` :: The element to render. Use span inside text and div inside blocks.
- `focusable` :: Shows the content while something inside it has keyboard focus, such as a skip link.
- `children` :: The content, which only assistive technology and the focus reveal show.
